entry_points.text: Entries include percpu acquire and release, refcount read and update, rt lock and generic rw lock and unlock across normal, irq and bottom-half.
Dynamic init for rwlocks, semaphores, seqlocks and counters takes per-site key with name and forwards to base init for unlocked zeroed start.
Optimistic open uses counter begin and retry; write takes spin then opens and closes then releases; low-level spin marks, acquires and orders.

exports.text: Per-CPU semaphore offers blocking, freezable and try shared acquire with release, plus init, held checks, dependency hooks and scoped guards.
Refcounts provide set, read, conditional add and increment with acquire and bounded forms, plus add, subtract and decrement tests and plain decrement.
Generic layer has rt mutex init and nested locks, plus rw shared and exclusive acquire, release, try, nested and irq, bottom-half and irq-saving shapes.
Realtime rw mirrors acquire, release, try and contention query; SMP adds shared and exclusive releases for irq-restore, irq-enable and bottom-half use.
Semaphores expose locked and contended checks, held assertions and guard constructors; counting semaphores allow static definition and dynamic init.
Counters give checked write open and close, optimistic begin with retry, latch sample and advance, and seqlocks pairing sampling with spin updates.
Spin offers plain, bottom-half, interrupt and flag-saving acquire and release, plus exclusive reads, optimistic-or-locked open and scoped retry.

hazards.text: Never raise zero except conditionally, exceed max, go negative or release at zero; all warn and leave saturated error not usable count.
Unsynchronized waiter sampling can see transient state and must stay advisory, never authoritative for correctness.
Open spins while odd so slow writers stall readers; when stabilization costs near lock cost, prefer attempt open with locking slow path.
Unchecked validation lacks read order so callers must supply it; raw latch relies on address dependency, retry supplies remainder.
Uniprocessor acquire may be plain store or barrier only; realtime may ignore flags and masking; contended queries may always say idle.
Preemption, irq save and restore, bottom-half, RCU idle, per-CPU adjustment, sleep checks and race marks live elsewhere and are only referenced.

invariants.text: Negative or wrapped values warn as saturated; add to zero, oversubtract and bad decrement enter saturated error; exact consume adds acquire order.
Rt owner null means unlocked else task pointer with waiter bit; lock test checks null and masks bit via racy reads; rw init binds class or unlocks.
Realtime irq forms keep flag arg but never mask, saving stores neutral; bottom-half brackets with suppression; contention always reports idle.
Even is stable and odd updating; open goes even to odd and close to next even; barrier jumps even to even, invalidate adds even, latch climbs.
Without nesting, subclass and nest aliases collapse to plain ops; static semaphores start zeroed and empty, counters start zero with cleared identity.

locks.text: Fast path runs only while synchronizer idle, bumping per-CPU count with preemption off; else slow helpers run, try tracks dependence only on success.
SMP holds preemption off, tracks dependence before arch primitive, retries on contention, extends across irq and bottom-half, and undoes hold when try fails.
Rt tree and owner use embedded raw guard; semaphore head uses wait guard, but contended check samples unlocked so it is only a hint.
Writers take embedded spin with context before opening counter and close before release; bottom-half, irq and flag forms need matching release.
Even input owns nothing and must validate, odd owns spin and must release via completion; scoped state tracks held lock for exact cleanup.

state_machines.text: Counts cycle positive owned, zero released and saturated error; bad raise or wrap enters saturated, exact consume enters zero with success.
Percpu uses fast bias while idle else slow path; classic seqcount goes even-odd-even, block and invalidate force slow or retry.
Scoped starts lockless; success finishes, failure escalates to plain, flag-saving or resample; locked finishes at once, past-finish is defect.

structs.text: Refcount wraps one signed atomic; max is INT_MAX, saturated is INT_MIN halved, init sets value, five-value enum tags saturation causes.
Rt mutex embeds base with wait lock, tree and owner; traditional rwlock wraps arch raw, realtime wraps rt base; debug signature is 0xdeaf1eed.
Traditional semaphore has count, owner, spinner, guard and queue; realtime has rt base only; unlocked is zero, exclusive uses lowest bit.
Base counter has one word plus optional dependency; associated adds guardian pointer; seqlock pairs counter with spin; latch wraps one; scoped has state.
Slow lock code sits in per-unit subsection with helpers; uniprocessor rw try always succeeds after barrier; sanitizer bound is one thousand.
